# infrawrench_cost_visibility_scope (Resource)

Restricts which costs a role, a member or an API key can see.

A scoped principal sees only matching cost rows on every surface: cost queries, reports, dashboard cards, budgets, showback, unit costs, forecasts, the chat agent, MCP tools and the CLI. The server applies the scope where cost queries are built, so no surface can forget it.

A row matches when it is on one of `account_ids` **or** allocates to one of `cost_centre_ids` (or a sub-centre), and, when `saved_filter_id` is set, also matches that saved filter. With no accounts and no centres the saved filter decides alone; a scope naming nothing hides every cost.

Every scope that applies to someone is **intersected**: a member scope can only narrow their role's, and an API key's scope can only narrow its owner. Owners cannot be scoped. Scoped principals are refused cost exports, invoices, the weekly digest, config as code and role or invitation changes, because those cover the whole organization.

Needs `team:role:write` for roles and members. An API key's owner can also scope their own key with `apikeys:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Everyone holding the Platform role sees only the spend allocated to the
# Platform cost centre (and its sub-centres) or billed to the shared account.
resource "infrawrench_cost_visibility_scope" "platform" {
  principal_kind  = "role"
  principal_id    = infrawrench_role.platform.id
  cost_centre_ids = [infrawrench_cost_centre.platform.id]
  account_ids     = [infrawrench_account.shared.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `principal_id` (String) The role id (`infrawrench_role.x.id`), the member's user id, or the API key id. Changing it replaces the scope.
- `principal_kind` (String) What the scope attaches to: `role`, `member` or `api_key`. Changing it replaces the scope.

### Optional

- `account_ids` (List of String) Connected accounts whose spend is visible (`infrawrench_account.x.id`). At most 200.
- `cost_centre_ids` (List of String) Cost centres whose allocated spend is visible, sub-centres included (`infrawrench_cost_centre.x.id`). At most 50.
- `saved_filter_id` (String) A saved filter ANDed onto the scope (`infrawrench_saved_filter.x.id`). While a scope references it, the saved filter cannot be deleted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned scope id. Import with `<principal_kind>/<principal_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Scopes are keyed by the principal they restrict: role, member or api_key,
# then that principal's id.
terraform import infrawrench_cost_visibility_scope.platform role/1a2b3c4d-5e6f-7a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
```
